rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act
rules.requirement: Landlords and foreclosing owners ending a tenancy must give the tenant a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources at the same time as the Notice to Quit or non-renewal notice. They must also send a copy of the notice with a Certificate of Compliance/Service to the Office of Housing Stability.
rules.key_value: Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources delivered with the Notice to Quit
rules.penalty: 1st offense: warning; 2nd and subsequent offenses: $300 per day. A violation does not halt the eviction process.
rules.status_basis: The HSNA becomes effective on November 6, 2020.

exempt_if.name: health_facility_residence
exempt_if.text: residences in any hospital, skilled nursing facility or health facility

exempt_if.name: substance_abuse_treatment_facility
exempt_if.text: residences in a non-profit facility whose primary purpose is providing short-term treatment, assistance or therapy for alcohol, drug, or other substance abuse

coverage.summary: Applies to all landlords and foreclosing owners intending to end a tenancy or post-foreclosure occupancy of a unit in Boston.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Only residences in hospitals, skilled nursing or health facilities, and non-profit short-term substance abuse treatment facilities are exempt.

rules.quoted_span: The Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources must be delivered at the same time as the Notice to Quit.
